non-tonal.label: Non-tonal
non-tonal.description: Pitch changes don't affect word meaning.

pitch-accent.label: Pitch-accent
pitch-accent.description: It uses pitch accent, where certain syllables are emphasized with pitch changes.

simple-tonal.label: Simple tonal
simple-tonal.description: Pitch changes moderately affect word meaning.

complex-tonal.label: Complex tonal
complex-tonal.description: Pitch patterns significantly affect word meaning.

isolating.label: Isolating
isolating.description: Words typically consist of single morphemes.

agglutinative.label: Agglutinative
agglutinative.description: Words are formed by adding affixes in sequence.

fusional.label: Fusional
fusional.description: Multiple grammatical meanings are combined in single morphemes.

polysynthetic.label: Polysynthetic
polysynthetic.description: Complex ideas can be expressed in single words.

semi-flexible.label: Semi-flexible
semi-flexible.description: Some variation of word order is allowed for emphasis.

flexible.label: Flexible
flexible.description: Various word arrangements are allowed for stylistic purposes.

very-flexible.label: Very flexible
very-flexible.description: Freedom in word arrangement is very extensive.
